req.title: 404 on unknown task id
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 404 and detail 'Task not found' when the id does not exist.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-009 requires HTTP 404 with a specific detail message when GET /tasks/{task_id} is called with a non-existent ID. The table is EMPTY before every test, so any task_id will be non-existent unless we first create one. Tests cover: (1) positive — a task that EXISTS returns 200 (not 404), proving the 404 branch is conditional; (2) negative/EP — a clearly non-existent ID returns exactly 404 with the correct detail string; (3) BVA boundary — task_id=1 after creating one task (exists → 200), then task_id=2 (does not exist → 404), probing the ±1 boundary around the only valid ID; (4) NEG — a large sentinel ID (999999) that can never exist returns 404; (5) DT — verifies the exact detail message text character-for-character to kill string-mutation operators. All tests use in-process FastAPI TestClient with a fresh SQLite in-memory override so they are isolated, deterministic, and idempotent.

tests.name: test_get_existing_task_returns_200_not_404
preconditions: A task is created via POST /tasks/ to obtain a valid task_id
actions: POST /tasks/ with title='Positive Task' to create a task
expected: Response body contains id matching the created task
trace: R-TASK-009: 404 must NOT fire when the task exists — validates the conditional branch
tests.executable:
import os, sys
os.environ.setdefault('DATABASE_URL', 'sqlite://')
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
from app.database import Base, get_db

engine_mem = create_engine('sqlite://', connect_args={'check_same_thread': False})
SessionMem = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine_mem)
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine_mem)

def override_get_db():
    db = SessionMem()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
client = TestClient(app)

def test_get_existing_task_returns_200_not_404():
    r_create = client.post('/tasks/', json={'title': 'Positive Task', 'completed': False})
    assert r_create.status_code == 201
    task_id = r_create.json()['id']
    r = client.get(f'/tasks/{task_id}')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body['id'] == task_id
    assert body['title'] == 'Positive Task'

tests.name: test_boundary_id_plus_one_returns_404
preconditions: Exactly one task is created so its id is 1
actions: GET /tasks/2 — should return 404 (id=max_existing+1 does not exist)
expected: Detail for /tasks/2 is exactly 'Task with id 2 not found'
trace: R-TASK-009: BVA at boundary — id immediately above the only existing id must trigger 404

def test_boundary_id_plus_one_returns_404():
    r_create = client3.post('/tasks/', json={'title': 'Boundary Task', 'completed': False})

    created_id = r_create.json()['id']

actions: Inspect the exact detail string character by character
expected: detail key present in JSON body
detail value is exactly 'Task with id 7 not found' — no variation in casing, punctuation, or wording

import os
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
from app.database import Base, get_db

engine_mem5 = create_engine('sqlite://', connect_args={'check_same_thread': False})
SessionMem5 = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine_mem5)
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine_mem5)

def override_get_db5():
    db = SessionMem5()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db5
client5 = TestClient(app)

def test_decision_table_detail_message_exact_format():
    r = client5.get('/tasks/7')
    assert r.status_code == 404
    body = r.json()
    assert list(body.keys()) == ['detail'] or 'detail' in body
    detail = body['detail']
    assert detail == 'Task with id 7 not found'
    assert detail != 'task with id 7 not found'
    assert detail != 'Task with id 7 not Found'
    assert 'Task with id 7' in detail
    assert 'not found' in detail
